name: ABSL_SBU_Business_agent
scope: Strategic Business Unit (SBU) based view of Akij Building Solutions Ltd: each SBU, its mandate, functions, processes, knowledge documents, rules, and data coverage
source: Google Sheet 'all file ABSL' (tabs: Powerplant, Utility, Electricial Maintenance, Mechanical Maintenance, Inventory, Production, Quality, Logistics & Distribution, ABSL Sust/Opex, ABSL HR & Admin, Legal, Procurement, Sales & Marketing, Policy List); SOP ARMCL-SLS-001; DWH database

sbus.mandate: Generate revenue and profitable growth through ready-mix concrete sales, credit-controlled customer acquisition, and long-term relationships
sbus.process: Plan -> Generate -> Acquire & Onboard -> Approve -> Order-to-Cash -> After-Sales & Retention -> Collection & Bad Debt -> Incentives -> Govern & Report
core_rules: Discount: <=3% ASM | 3-7% HoS | 7-10% HoS+Finance | >10% or below breakeven CEO/MD
Credit limit: <=50 lac ASM | 50 lac-5 cr HoS+Finance | >5 cr CEO/MD+Finance
Overdue >60 days triggers auto credit hold
All orders booked in IBOS; same-day cutoff 3h before batching
sbus.mcp_coverage: High for transactional data (orders, invoices, partners, targets); low for policy docs, complaints, incentives, meeting minutes
sbus.knowledge_status: 12 items; 8 links point to a single private Google Doc (401); 2 missing (Market Research, Marketing Policy); 1 pending (weekly minutes)

sbus.mandate: Produce ready-mix concrete per IBOS schedule with quality compliance, capacity utilization, and cost efficiency
sbus.process: IBOS production plan -> material preparation -> batching -> QC check -> dispatch handover
core_rules: QC informed before each production run

sbus.mandate: Ensure consistent quality of raw materials and ready-mix concrete per approved mix designs and project specs
sbus.process: Raw material QC -> batching QC (slump, cubes) -> delivery QC -> complaint investigation
core_rules: Technical disputes verified via QC before credit note
sbus.mcp_coverage: Complaint linkage via DWH; quality reports local

sbus.mandate: Deliver ready-mix concrete from plant to site on time with fleet optimization and cost efficiency
sbus.process: Delivery schedule -> TM/pump allocation -> dispatch -> in-transit -> site confirmation
core_rules: Priority to time-bound pours, government/large sites, strategic customers
Exceptions approved by Plant Manager or Sales Head, logged in IBOS
sbus.mcp_coverage: Order/delivery data in DWH; diesel report local

sbus.mandate: Manage raw material and finished goods inventory to support production without stockout or excess holding
sbus.process: Stock planning -> receipt -> storage -> issue -> reconciliation

sbus.mandate: Operate plant power generation reliably and efficiently to support production
Manage utilities (water, air, power distribution) for plant operations
Ensure electrical systems reliability for plant and equipment
sbus.process: Preventive maintenance -> breakdown repair -> safety compliance

sbus.mandate: Maintain mechanical equipment (mixers, transit mixers, pumps) for uptime and safety
sbus.process: Preventive maintenance -> breakdown repair -> parts management

sbus.mandate: Drive sustainability initiatives and operational expenditure optimization
Manage the workforce across ABSL/ARMCL: recruitment, payroll, performance, welfare
core_rules: Incentive eligibility and payroll processing (sales incentives, referral program)
sbus.mcp_coverage: Employee master, attendance, leave, JD, org in DWH

sbus.mandate: Provide legal oversight for contracts, agreements, compliance, and debt recovery
core_rules: Bad debt write-off requires legal opinion for bankruptcies

sbus.mandate: Source raw materials (cement, aggregates, admixtures), spare parts, and services at optimal cost
sbus.process: Requisition -> RFQ -> negotiation -> PO -> receipt -> payment

sbus.mandate: Central registry of all ABSL/ARMCL policies, SOPs, and knowledge documents
knowledge_documents: All policies and SOPs across SBUs
core_rules: Every knowledge item must have a verifiable link or attached file
sbus.mcp_coverage: None - policies live in private Google Docs (GAP G1, G2)
sbus.knowledge_status: Knowledge audit flags: 8 of 12 Sales & Marketing links point to one private doc (401)

gaps.detail: Policy/SOP documents live in private Google Docs (shared doc 401)
gaps.impact: Cannot verify or read policy content through MCP

gaps.detail: PolicyHeaderArc = 0 ARMCL rows; empSOPArc = 0 ARMCL rows
gaps.impact: No programmatic access to authoritative rules

gaps.detail: Live orders, credit hold, customer statements in iBOS web (login-gated)

Cannot audit incentive rules or payouts

Ingest Sales SOP + policies into saas.empSOPArc / saas.PolicyHeaderArc
Build an iBOS REST connector for live orders, credit hold, and customer statements
Seed sms.tblEmployeeIncentiveArc for ARMCL; enforce grievance logging
Attach weekly meeting minutes to Drive and link them in the register
Audit the remaining 12 SBU tabs in 'all file ABSL' the same way as Sales & Marketing
